entries.subject: DAMIT 16309: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-16309.txt. Model 16309, version 2025-07-08, pole (95°, -89°), period 20.70802 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Franco et al. (2025), Preliminary Spin-Shape Model for 49 Pales
entries.finding: [Franco et al. (2025), Preliminary Spin-Shape Model for 49 Pales](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MPBu...52..202F) — original model publication record.

entries.subject: AKARI AcuA
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — included as an explicitly approximate thermal size transfer. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 148.02 ± 2.56 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented. The original catalogue row for asteroid 49 was retrieved again and matched field-for-field with the retained row, including diameter, reported error and detection count.

entries.subject: Resolved-model surveys: body-specific candidate not established
entries.finding: The imported survey cites Hanuš 2017, Viikinkoski 2017 and Vernazza 2021 without identifying a selected product for this body. The current DAMIT reference join does not bind selected model 16309 to those surveys. This does not prove that no resolved model exists elsewhere; a body-specific candidate and its release must be identified before the entry can count as included.
entries.revisitWhen: A target row, supplementary model or release URL from one of these surveys establishes a concrete candidate and permits comparison with the selected shape.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale "74.01 km (approximate thermal scale)" (akari-acua-v1) implies a diameter of 148.02 km, outside the added NEOWISE V2.0 neowise_mainbelt.csv record 139469 (Masiero et al. 2012) diameter 166.252 ± 2.166 km (NEOWISE, NEATM). Both are shown; the display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
